definitions.explanation: A local office or division of a larger organization.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大阪|おおさか}→大阪：09779_oosaka⟧{支部|しぶ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}いている→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: I work at the Osaka branch.

examples.japanese: ⟦{全国|ぜんこく}→全国：03311_zenkoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{支部|しぶ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are branches throughout the country.

examples.japanese: {支部|しぶ}{長|ちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}して→連絡する：20202_renrakusuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。

notes:
A local division of a larger organization, such as a political party, labor union, professional association, or non-profit.

FORMS:
{支|し} (branch, support) + ⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧ (section, division)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {支部|しぶ}{長|ちょう}: branch manager/director
- ⟦{地方|ちほう}→地方：02369_chihou⟧{支部|しぶ}: regional branch
- {支部|しぶ}⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧: branch meeting
- {支部|しぶ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設|もう}ける→設ける：14220_moukeru⟧: to establish a branch

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{本部|ほんぶ}→本部：00112_honbu⟧: headquarters (opposite of {支部|しぶ})
- ⟦{支店|してん}→支店：03185_shiten⟧: branch store/office (commercial businesses)
- {支社|ししゃ}: branch office (corporate)
- ⟦{出張所|しゅっちょうじょ}→出張所：18505_shucchoujo⟧: field office, satellite office

{支部|しぶ} is typically used for non-commercial organizations, while ⟦{支店|してん}→支店：03185_shiten⟧ and {支社|ししゃ} are for businesses.
